targets.query:
from(bucket: "grafana_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "job_details")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["job_id"] == "${job_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "metric_a")

from(bucket: "grafana_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "job_details")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["job_id"] == "${job_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "metric_b")

from(bucket: "grafana_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "job_details")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["job_id"] == "${job_id}")
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "step_name", "log_level", "message"])
